question: How is the visualized deity regarded and attended by groups of sages?
premises: Various groups of sages see the deity.
The same sages serve the deity.
The deity is characterized by all sports or playful acts.
inference: The deity is to be visualized as seen and served by various groups of sages amid all his playful acts.
plain_english: Visualize him as seen and served by various groups of sages, engaged in all his playful sports.
